description: Source code for command-line options handling in the lu5 scripting environment, including functions for help, version, init, log level, and install options.

methods.name: lu5_option_log
methods.description: Handles setting the log level for lu5, parsing the argument and updating the log level.

methods.name: lu5_option_init
methods.description: Creates a new lu5 sketch file, prompting for overwrite if file exists.

methods.name: lu5_option_install
methods.description: Installs a lu5 sketch globally, checking for hashbang and setting execute permissions.

methods.name: lu5_option_version
methods.description: Displays the current version of lu5.

methods.name: lu5_option_help
methods.description: Displays help information for all command-line options.
